name: Witch Lord (Champion Archetype)
body:
Witch Lords are the elite commanders of the Champions of Hecate. Only a handful of people in the world bear this title. They are all ranking members of Hecate’s cult leadership and each controls a large faction within the cult.

Background. Witch Lords always have a long and distinguished history with the temple of Hecate. They have served as acolytes, initiates, and champions for many years. As a result of this history, they have deep connections within the cult and the broader temple community.

Adventures. As cult leaders, Witch Lords concern themselves only with the most important issues. A Witch Lord may take matters into her own hands when the temple’s primary objectives are at risk, when the cult is threatened, or when the goddess herself requires it.

Requirements

To qualify to become a Witch Lord, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Base Attack Bonus: +6
Skills: Knowledge Arcana 8 ranks, Knowledge Religion 8 ranks
Feats: Any one Metamagic Feat
Special: Guardian Sight ability
Class Skills

The Witch Lord’s class skills are Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Handle Animal (Cha), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), and Spellcraft (Int).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 4 + Int modifier

Hit Die: d10

Table: The Witch Lord
Level	Base Attack	Fort	Ref	Will	Special	Spells per Day
1	+1	+1	+0	+1	Lay on hands, pilgrim of the roads	+1 level of existing class
2	+2	+1	+1	+1	Mercy	+1 level of existing class
3	+3	+2	+1	+2	Aura of witchery	+1 level of existing class
4	+4	+2	+1	+2	Herb pouch	+1 level of existing class
5	+5	+3	+2	+3	Witch champion	+1 level of existing class
Class Features

The following are all features of the Witch Lord.

Lay on Hands (Su)

The Witch Lord’s class levels are added to their Champion of Hecate levels when determining the number of uses and amount of healing granted by their Lay on Hands ability.

Pilgrim of the Roads (Ex)

At 1st level, your speed increases by 10 feet and you gain a bonus metamagic feat of your choice whose prerequisites you must meet.

Mercy (Su)

At 2nd level, a Witch Lord can select one mercy. Each mercy adds an effect to the Witch Lord’s lay on hands ability. Whenever the Witch Lord uses lay on hands to heal damage to one target, the target also receives the additional effects from all of the mercies possessed by the Witch Lord. A mercy can remove a condition caused by a curse, disease, or poison without curing the affliction. Such conditions return after 1 hour unless the mercy actually removes the affliction that causes the condition. At 2nd level, a Witch Lord adds the following mercies to the list of those that can be selected.

Amputated: The champion’s lay on hands also acts as regenerate, but only for the purposes of regrowing severed body members, broken bones, and ruined organs. The champion must have the injured mercy before she can select this mercy.
Blinded: The target is no longer blinded.
Deafened: The target is no longer deafened.
Ensorcelled: The champion’s lay on hands also acts as dispel magic, using the Witch Lord’s character level as her caster level (maximum 20).
Paralyzed: The target is no longer paralyzed.
Petrified: The Witch Lord’s lay on hands ability also acts as stone to flesh, but only for the purpose of removing the petrified condition from a creature.
Stunned: The target is no longer stunned.

Aura of Witchery: At 3rd level, a Witch Lord’s weapons are treated as magical for the purposes of overcoming Damage Reduction. Any attack made against an enemy within 10 feet of her is treated as magical for the purposes of overcoming Damage Reduction.

This ability functions only while the Witch Lord is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead.

Herb Pouch (Su)

At 4th level, you gain a magic pouch of herbs that enhances your mercy ability. You add any 3 mercies of your choice to your list of known mercies.

Witch Champion (Su)

At 5th level, a Witch Lord becomes a conduit for the power of Hecate. Her DR increases to 10/evil. Whenever she uses smite and successfully strikes an outsider, the outsider is also subject to a banishment, using her total character level as the caster level (her weapon and holy symbol automatically count as objects that the subject hates). After the banishment effect and the damage from the attack is resolved, the smite immediately ends. In addition, whenever she channels energy or uses lay on hands to heal a creature, she heals the maximum possible amount.
